parsed.explanation: State-directed, traveller-facing exposure is documented across a decade. Entry screening compares appearance with passport sex, with X-ray anatomy checks, refusals, confiscated passports and deportations at the two main gateways (2013, 2016, 2022, 2025). Gender presentation is criminalised under Art. 412(2) and was enforced against visitors in mixed public places, with detention in a cell designated by presentation, discarded hormones and deportation. Police campaigns against transsexuals, forced treatment and torture-level custody abuse are documented, and there is no legal recognition, anti-discrimination protection or operating organisation. Consensual same-sex conduct is criminalised but enforced only through a complainant mechanism. No execution is documented, and visitor-specific frequency is unquantified, so this sits in the severe band rather than near 0.05. Absence of documented incidents in other emirates is not counted as safety. The pattern resembles the severe-risk anchors.
